generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A readiness certificate can be valid when published yet become stale if any later material repository write occurs before the delivery response.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Cache the publication result and skip a fresh remote identity check after subsequent writes.
trigger_signals: result-only child published before all repository writes are finished
remote head changes after handoff publication
post-publication delta contains a non-result path
generalized_learning.reusable_control: After the last write, compare the published result head with a fresh remote head and classify the complete delta before handing control to an independent auditor.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Do not publish the terminal result child until all material edits and material CI remediations are complete; any later material write invalidates the freeze.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: A fresh terminal reconciliation must fail closed whenever current head differs from the published result child and the delta contains any non-result path.

transfer_cases.scenario: A test-only commit lands after a valid handoff publication.
A documentation commit lands after a valid handoff publication.

skill_changes.evidence: terminal-handoff protocol requires post-write refreeze after any material write.
terminal-handoff guard requires a fresh remote current_head check and complete post-publication delta classification.
